recentItems.title: Maathu Neene Promo | My Baby | Nidhi Films Production | Preetham Gubbi | Jaskaran | Nagarajun, Nakul
recentItems.description:
Presenting Maathu Neene, the first song from Preetham Gubbi’s My Baby. A love ballad that finds its rhythm in the mountains, beautifully composed by Nakul Abhyankar, penned by Nagarjun Sharma and brought to life by the soulful voice of Jaskiran Singh.

Exclusively only On Anand Audio Official Youtube Channel..!!! 

Two hearts, one soul, and a melody that brings them closer amidst the mountains. Some love stories are best told through music, and Sumukha and Esha, as Preetham and Arya, are here to take you on one such journey.

Some melodies don't just touch your heart. They stay with you. ❤️
